subject: Day 16: cluster feeding likely tonight; supply calibration
bodyText:
Today's focus
Day 16. Cluster feeding is likely tonight or in the next 48 hours as the growth spurt unfolds. The mother's supply will respond — feeding on demand is the cleanest way to calibrate. If formula-feeding, increase volume gradually as Avi shows he can finish bottles.

Action items
- Confirm the 1-month well visit on the calendar (target day 28-35). Bring the feeding log. AAP Bright Futures periodicity: https://www.aap.org/en/practice-management/bright-futures/bright-futures-tools-and-resources/
- Stock easy meals for the next 48 hours. The growth spurt eats the mother's reserves if breastfeeding.
- Verify health insurance enrollment for Avi has processed. Healthcare.gov QLE reference: https://www.healthcare.gov/glossary/qualifying-life-event/
- If both parents are home, take an hour off-shift today. Postpartum sleep debt accumulates non-linearly. ACOG on the postpartum period: https://www.acog.org/womens-health/faqs/postpartum-pain-management
- Continue feeding log.

Watch-fors
- [low concern] Cluster feeding tonight; increased holding requirement; baby acne resolving.
- [low concern] Lochia alba or stopping.
- [monitor] Maternal mood persistently low or anxious beyond week 2. CDC overview of postpartum depression: https://www.cdc.gov/reproductive-health/depression/index.html
- [call within 24h] Forceful projectile vomiting with weight loss (pyloric stenosis presents weeks 3-6). Fewer than six wet diapers per day. Maternal pelvic pain, foul-smelling discharge, or fever.
- [call now] Rectal temperature at or above 100.4F (38.0C). Lethargy, refusing all feeds, blue or grey color, breathing faster than 60 per minute at rest, persistent grunting, projectile or bilious-green vomiting. Maternal chest pain or vision changes — call OB or 911. Call 911 for blue lips or unresponsiveness!

Enrichment opportunity
Live music exposure during an awake-alert window — sing or hum to Avi for 2-5 minutes. The active ingredient for prosodic-pattern learning is live human voice. Trainor LJ et al., Dev Sci 2012: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22356269/

Upcoming
- Day 16-21: growth spurt likely 24-48 hours of cluster feeding.
- Day 28-35: 1-month well visit; first social smiles begin.
- Day 35-42: peak PURPLE crying curve at about 6 weeks.
- Day 42: maternal 6-week postpartum visit.

Further reading
- CDC on postpartum depression: https://www.cdc.gov/reproductive-health/depression/index.html
- ACOG on the postpartum period: https://www.acog.org/womens-health/faqs/postpartum-pain-management
- AAP HealthyChildren first month overview: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/Pages/default.aspx
- Cribsheet by Emily Oster: https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/562146/cribsheet-by-emily-oster/
